title: Ukuganduka gukomeye kwa Nyagasani
intro: Usanga uri mu gihugu cy'ibitangaza bya kera n'ibyahishuwe bikomeye. Umutegetsi ukomeye, ahura n'ubutumire butunguranye, yatangiye urugendo rwahinduraga inzira y'iherezo rye n'ukwizera kw'abaturage be. Ese ushobora kumenya uwo muntu w'icyubahiro?
clues: Nategetse ubwami bukize, buriho ubutunzi butagira ingano n'intebe y'ubwami ihebuje.
Jye n'umuryango wanjye twasengaga umubiri wo mu ijuru, twizera ko ari wo mwami wacu, nubwo nari mfite gushidikanya mu mutima wanjye.
Intumwa idasanzwe, inyoni, yampaye ibaruwa, impamagarira jye n'abantu banjye kuyoboka Imana Imwe Rukumbi.
Nagishije inama abajyanama banjye, bari bafite imbaraga nyinshi, ku buryo nakwitabira ubu butumwa butigeze bubaho.
Nahisemo kohereza impano y'agaciro ku muntu wohereje ibaruwa, niringiye gupima imbaraga ze n'imigambi ye.
Nkigerayo, natangajwe no kubona ingoro ifite hasi hakozwe mu kirahure, isa n'ikidendezi cy'amazi, maze icyo gihe ntangaza ko nemeye kugandukira Umwami w'ibiremwa byose.
arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verse: Indeed, I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great (23) (27:23)
